d: The fairy tale match between Kim VanPelt and Sandy Ozment turns into a nightmare after Sandy is found fatally beaten. Authorities hunt for the killer who destroyed wedded bliss.
When single mom Debbie falls for salesman Bernard, they roll the dice and wed in Vegas. Their joy goes bust when the bride vanishes, and a fanatical secret obsession is uncovered.
Cupid's arrow hits the mark with Bruce and his gal Janice. But during a three-month anniversary hunting trip, a bullet shatters their union. But who fired it?
When Oscar waltzes into Vic's life, they both know it's forever. But soon death finds its way into the couple's life and police must bring a killer to justice.
The sudden disappearance of the soon-to-be-wed Bipsy and Mickey leads police to untangle a tale of obsession and twisted religion.
Kelly is whisked away in a fairytale romance by her millionaire boyfriend Michael. But too soon, tragedy strikes and detectives must unravel a tale of cruel deceit.

In a gruesome 1989 case, Tracey Wigginton and her accomplices lure Edward Baldock with promises of a good time, only to brutally stab him to death, sparking a sensational trial that raised questions about the roles of her accomplices.

In 1991, Ray and Faye Copeland, the oldest death row couple in the USA, are convicted of murdering five drifters. Police find the bodies after a tip-off. Faye's death sentence is commuted to life in 1999.

In February 1977, Australian heiress Janie Shepherd vanishes in London. David Lashley, a convicted rapist, later confesses to her murder in prison. In 1990, he is convicted based on this confession and sentenced to life.
In 1999, NFL player Rae Carruth is convicted for orchestrating the shooting of his pregnant girlfriend. He is sentenced to 18-24 years. Their son, Chancellor, has cerebral palsy.

University students Holly Dunn and Chris Maier are ambushed along railway tracks in August 1997. By 1999, a string of similar attacks leads police to Angel Maturino Reséndiz, who travels by freight train between murders across three states.

In July 2000, Sarah Payne is abducted and murdered. Roy Whiting, a convicted sex offender, is found guilty and sentenced to life in 2001. Sarah’s case leads to the implementation of “Sarah’s Law” in the UK in 2011.

In 2004, Marc Dutroux was sentenced to life for kidnapping, raping, and murdering young girls in Belgium. His 1996 arrest and delayed trial exposed horrific crimes and official failings, sparking public outrage.

On June 28, 2005, Joan Porco attends the trial of her son Christopher, accused of murdering his father and attacking her. Despite her initial identification and later refusal to testify, Christopher is found guilty based on circumstantial evidence.

In 2001, British traveler Peter Falconio is presumed murdered in the Australian outback. Joanne Lees survives the attack, and Bradley John Murdoch is convicted of the murder in 2005. Peter's body is never found.

South California is the perfect place to retire, but when an 84-year-old is brutally raped and murdered in her senior living community everyone is a suspect. To find her killer, the investigation goes global as the suspect does his best to slip away.
An 18-year-old runaway is found raped and strangled to death on the side of a San Diego road. Tracking down the cold-blooded killer will take years of detective work and a benign connection.

In a sleepy New Hampshire town, a man answers a knock at the door and is shot dead through the screen. Investigators are stumped. That is, until they uncover a seething grudge and a culprit closer to home than anyone could have imagined.

A glamorous flight attendant disappears and the story makes headlines. An intense search reveals few clues. But a graveside discovery eventually forces police to take a second look at some already familiar faces.

On November 1st 1994, respected New Jersey rabbi, Fred Neulander, returns home to find his 52-year-old wife, Carol, dead on the living room floor. She has been savagely beaten and the cash from her successful bakery business is gone.

On New Year’s Eve 1991, 45-year-old Catherine Carroll is stabbed 53 times and dies on the bathroom floor of her Newfoundland home. Her 19-year-old son discovers the grizzly scene, and a week later, is arrested and charged with murder.
Fourteen-year-old Karen Slattery is brutally stabbed and raped while babysitting in South Florida’s upscale Delray Beach. Police follow up on dozens of tips but the case goes cold.
